name: Item selection drawer
explanation: When a definition opens from a slide Item, shows that Item's exact selections before the definition's complete code: declared path, selected lines at the observed head, containing-reference staleness and selected-byte integrity as separate facts, and unresolved reasons without substitution.

code.note: Reads the Item as saved, refuses to show selections against a different pin, resolves each declared path and reports selected, containing and digest facts separately.
